artworks.title: Quayside Figures and a Length of Rope Attached to a Bollard
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various figures engaged in different activities. The drawing depicts sketched figures in various poses engaging with objects such as a scale and a piece of cloth. The foreground includes a coil of rope and a bollard with a sack resting on it. The sketch emphasizes dynamic postures and interactions, capturing a scene bustling with activity. Each figure is drawn with light, precise lines suggesting movement. The drawing has an element of spontaneity, as if capturing candid snapshots of a busy port or market.

artworks.title: Namculdroog: Droog and Tank
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Edward J. Lenkin Fund and Diana and Mallory Walker Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a view of a hill with a fort-like structure on top. A dirt road curves from the right side into the distance. Sparse vegetation and shrubs line the road. In the distance, there's a small structure and some trees. The sky is mostly clear with a light gray tone. The photograph has a grainy texture.

artworks.title: The Tiara
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint and aquatint on parchment
artworks.description: This is a painting of a papal tiara above a surreal landscape. The painting features the tiara placed in the center of the composition. Below the tiara, a cherubic face with small wings emerges from the clouds. The background showcases a dreamy landscape with faint architectural silhouettes visible in the distance. The sky is filled with a misty and cloud-like texture.

artworks.title: Frattelini Circus
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint in black on vellum
artworks.description: The image is an etching featuring multiple figures in a performance setting. The central characters are seated or standing, some in wheelchairs. The figures have distinct facial features, varying expressions, and wear theatrical costumes with ruffles. Musical instruments, including a guitar, are present. The background includes structural elements suggesting a stage-like environment with a large arched entrance or curtain and visible ropes. Small sketches at the bottom show individual heads and a building structure.

artworks.title: Joseph Sold into Slavery
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in gray and black from three blocks on old mount
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures and camels in a landscape setting. The image depicts a gathering of multiple figures with draped clothing and gesturing postures, seemingly engaged in a scene of discussion or exchange. The figures are centrally placed and surrounded by camels on the right side. In the foreground, there is an object resembling a large dish or lid, and a carved inscription is apparent at the bottom of the image. The composition is rendered with intricate linework and shading. The background features mountainous terrain under a sky.

artworks.title: A Corner of a Rental Garden
artworks.medium: black chalk with graphite, heightened with white gouache
artworks.description: The image shows an outdoor rustic setting. The viewpoint is at eye level, capturing trees and structures that obscure the horizon. The artwork features sketch-like brush strokes with light and shadow. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of black, white, and gray. In the scene, a wooden barrel receives water from a pipe, and a wooden fence runs diagonally. A small wooden structure is visible among leafless trees. Branches create patterns against the light sky, which is overcast or partially cloudy.

artworks.title: Manuscript Leaf from a Book of Hours (incip. Passionis)
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gouache and gold leaf on vellum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Stanley and Wilhelmina Jashemski in honor of her parents, Professor Howard C. Feemster and Emma L. Feemster
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorated manuscript page. The image features an ornate design with illuminated letters and intricate floral borders. The text is in Latin, written in a Gothic script, with larger, stylized letters at the beginning of paragraphs. Floral motifs and vine patterns, painted in vibrant colors including gold, blue, and red, frame the text. Illustrations of a bird and a peacock are integrated into the decorative borders. A small heraldic shield appears just below the middle of the page, adding a heraldic element to the composition. The craftsmanship and artistry associated with illuminated manuscript traditions are showcased, inviting viewers to appreciate the detailed embellishments and the skillful blending of text and imagery.

artworks.title: Manuscript Leaf from a Bible (Deuteronomy)
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with red, white, and blue gouache and gold leaf on vellum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Stanley and Wilhelmina Jashemski in honor of her parents, Professor Howard C. Feemster and Emma L. Feemster
artworks.description: This is a painting of a historical manuscript page featuring intricate text and ornamental artwork. The page is filled with carefully aligned script, bordered by decorative elements and a large illuminated initial that includes a small detailed portrait within the letter. The text is written in Latin and the style of the script is consistent with Gothic or medieval calligraphy. Embellishments include vibrant reds and blues, with rubrication and marginal details adding to the artistry. The illuminated letter features a figure dressed in period attire, nestled at the center of a large letter 'P'. Additional decorative scrolling elements extend vertically down the length of the page. This is in the style of illuminated manuscripts from the medieval period.

artworks.title: Manuscript Leaf from a Book of Hours
artworks.medium: gouache with pen and ink on vellum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Stanley and Wilhelmina Jashemski in honor of her parents, Professor Howard C. Feemster and Emma L. Feemster
artworks.description: This is a painting of an illuminated manuscript page. The page features two distinct scenes enclosed in ornate, colorful square frames alongside the script. One scene depicts a group of figures in an indoor setting. The other scene features a group of figures in an outdoor setting, where a man carrying a staff leads a woman and a child. The text is written in a gothic script with alternating colors of black and red, and blue initials adorned with gold leaf.

artworks.title: Manuscript Leaf from the Beauvais Missal
artworks.medium: pen and ink with gouache and gold on vellum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Stanley and Wilhelmina Jashemski in honor of her parents, Professor Howard C. Feemster and Emma L. Feemster
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorated manuscript page. It contains Latin text written in neat black gothic script with red highlights. Each column of text is framed by elaborately decorated initials with spiraling foliage and small creatures. The page features intricate marginalia, including birds and mythical figures in blue, red, and gold colors. Musical notations at the top suggest it may be part of a liturgical text.

artworks.title: Two Children Seated near Overgrown Ruins
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: A landscape view from a slightly elevated point overlooking a rugged terrain. Dark clouds dominate the sky. Rocks and shrubbery are dispersed throughout the scene. Two figures are seated on the right. The brushstrokes are soft yet defined, with lines and shading creating depth and texture. The color palette consists of warm sepia tones. A pathway curves through the scene leading towards hills in the distance.

artworks.title: Meadow with Children
artworks.medium: etching on japan paper
artworks.description: The image shows a natural scene from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is in the upper third with a line of trees and a body of water extending across it, appearing in the distance. The brushstrokes are fine and detailed, creating intricate textures in the foliage and grass. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of black and gray contrasting against the lighter sky. Closest to us, a figure is depicted reclining on the grass under the shadow of a large tree to the left. In the background, the sky is mostly clear, enhancing the silhouette of the trees and the tranquil mood of the image.

artworks.title: Sunset in an Oriental Landscape
artworks.medium: watercolor, gouache, and gum arabic, with scraping and incising into wet paint, on cardboard
artworks.creditLine: Helen Porter and James T. Dyke Fund
artworks.description: The painting shows a view of a lush landscape with a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is in the middle of the composition, meeting a sunrise or sunset. Distant hills and the remains of an ancient structure are visible. The brushstrokes are smooth and detailed, depicting foliage and textures. The color scheme includes earth tones transitioning from greens and browns to yellows, oranges, and pinks in the sky. A path with two figures leads into the scene, surrounded by trees and ruins.

artworks.title: Madame Helleu Cradling Paulette in Her Arms
artworks.medium: black, red, and white chalk on buff paper

artworks.title: Seaside Studies
artworks.medium: charcoal with traces of pen and brown ink and brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This image is a pencil sketch on paper with a monochrome palette of graphite gray. The viewer sees various scenes without a defined horizon line. The upper section shows figures in period clothing, possibly mid-19th century women's fashion. The middle area has abstract architectural forms. In the lower right corner, a sailing ship or boat is sketched with more detail than the rest. The drawing style consists of quick, expressive strokes. The image conveys multiple narrative or compositional ideas on a single sheet.

artworks.title: Laundry (La Lessive)
artworks.medium: woodcut on dark pink wove paper
artworks.description: The image contains curving and zigzagging lines within a rectangular section on a red background. Some lines converge to form shapes resembling faces or animal heads with stylized eyes and snouts. The central abstract formations could be interpreted as landscapes or flowing water, contrasting with the rectangular form.

artworks.title: Studies for Jewelry Designs [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite and pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a collection of abstract sketches made of curving lines, circles, and vertical brushstrokes. One page shows swirling lines resembling oversized combs and butterflies, coiled springs, and knotted ropes. The other page features sequences of small circles resembling beads, arcs reminiscent of shells or musical notes, and sinuous figures suggesting serpents or smoke, giving a sense of movement and an organic quality to the drawing.

artworks.title: Studies for Jewelry Designs [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite on an envelope of laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an envelope with abstract sketches. The image shows a simple paper envelope with faint pencil sketches. Near the top center of the flap, there is a drawing that resembles a small creature or abstract shape made of delicate and swirling lines. On the body of the envelope, another abstract drawing is visible, with flowing and curled lines suggesting motion or a spiraling form. The envelope appears plain, with some faint imprints or marks.

artworks.title: Sheet of Sketches [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil drawing of three large fish in a circular pattern at the top of the page. The drawing is in grayscale on plain light-colored paper. Below the fish, there is a sketch of a bouquet of flowers with a cylindrical object and a leaf to the left.

artworks.title: A Young Man Sitting on a Stool Reading a Book (recto); The Fall of Man (a fragment of the lower part) (verso)
artworks.artist: Florentine 15th Century (possibly Domenico Veneziano or Luca della Robbia)
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink heightened with white gouache on laid paper (recto); black chalk with pen and brown ink (verso)
artworks.creditLine: William B. O'Neal Fund and Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body sketch of a seated figure from head to toe. The person is seated with one leg crossed over the other, leaning slightly forward, and holding a book or a board on a stand with their left hand. The figure's head is angled downwards towards the object, with short textured hair. They are draped in minimal cloth around the waist. The drawing emphasizes the body's contours and musculature with a light tone against a dark background. The background is a plain blue surface, providing a stark contrast to the figure.

artworks.title: The Spinario
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts a seated male figure removing a thorn from his foot. Known as "Il Spinario," the figure appears youthful with a muscular build, detailed anatomy, and curly hair. The subject is shown in a naturalistic pose, with one leg lifted and crossed over the other to access the thorn in his foot. The sculpture seems to be made of a material resembling marble or stone, with a smooth surface texture and shading techniques implying solidity and weight. The figure is caught in an intimate moment, appearing thoughtful and introspective. It rests on a round, intricately detailed pedestal, elevating the figure for better appreciation. The overall presentation is monochromatic in shades of grey, giving a timeless and classic aesthetic.

artworks.title: The Raising of Lazarus
artworks.artist: Gaetano Zompini, after Giovanni Benedetto Castiglione
artworks.medium: etching in sanguine on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing illustrating a group of people around a stone tomb or cave entrance. Some figures are kneeling and standing with gestures of amazement or awe. On the right, a figure in flowing robes raises an arm commandingly toward another figure emerging from the cave on the left. The scene conveys surprise and revelation, with expressive postures and light emanating from the central figure's hand. The detailed linework and contrast between light and shadow give the image depth and dynamism, focusing on the interaction between the figures.

artworks.title: The Flight into Egypt with a Shepherd Watching from Behind a Tree
artworks.artist: Gaetano Zompini, after Giovanni Benedetto Castiglione
artworks.medium: etching in sanguine on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral scene with a tree slightly right of center, a woman riding a donkey with an infant, a man walking beside them, another man leaning on the tree, and cattle and sheep crossing a small bridge guided by a shepherd. In the background are hills, sparse trees, a low horizon, sky with clouds, and fine linework typical of etching with cross-hatching creating depth. A monochromatic palette of various shades of brown evokes a timeless and tranquil rural ambiance.

artworks.title: A Pastoral Journey with a Mother and Child on Horesback and an Elderly Shepherd Seated
artworks.artist: Gaetano Zompini, after Giovanni Benedetto Castiglione
artworks.medium: etching in sanguine on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape scene with figures and animals on rocky terrain. The horizon line is at the top, dividing clouds from the landscape below. A man gestures towards a flock of sheep on a winding path. A figure leads the flock, and a woman rides a donkey on a rock. The scene suggests rugged travel, with a delicate, monochromatic color palette.
